coverage.explanation: The visible entry is the PUT /{id} handler. Its typed CurrentUser parameter supplies the caller at entry, and after lookup the handler requires item existence before evaluating authorization.

The UUID path id is passed to session.get(Item, id); the retrieved item's owner_id is then compared directly with current_user.id, binding the selected resource to the policy's ownership relation.
